summary: Develop practical skills in healthcare capacity, patient flow and operational reporting. Explore the five-day course and plan your next step.
lede: Healthcare management training helps supervisors, service coordinators and emerging managers coordinate service capacity, staffing and patient flow. It develops practical skills in mapping patient pathways and handoffs, assessing demand and capacity, and planning workforce coverage; learners also review service indicators, identify workflow risks and create an operational action plan.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who coordinate healthcare services or contribute to operational decisions, reporting and service improvement.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with a healthcare service setting is useful. No coding or programming is required.
